title: Pacific, Excelsior and Pickwick brass bands of the old days
summary: Older Algiers and New Orleans brass bands: the Pacific band, Golden Leaf, Excelsior with Peter Bocage, and the Pickwick; they were organized, uniformed and read music from the Red Book.
